# Day Cluster Visual

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The visual tools and generated diagrams associated with a Day Cluster, used to represent the day's structure or data graphically.

## Scope note

The day-cluster generator's visual output; distinct from the textual notes in DayClusterCore/Support/Health.
